title: 河边的照片
summary: A photographer returns to the riverfront to find the person who took an old photo, exploring memory and urban change.
topic: An old photograph and a changed riverfront

blocks.hanzi: 李伟是一个摄影师，他喜欢拍摄城市的变化。
blocks.translation: Li Wei is a photographer. He likes to photograph the changes of the city.
blocks.pinyin: Lǐ Wěi shì yī gè shèyǐngshī, tā xǐhuān pāishè chéngshì de biànhuà.

blocks.hanzi: 一天，他在家里找到一张旧照片。
blocks.translation: One day, he found an old photo at home.
blocks.pinyin: yì tiān, tā zài jiā lǐ zhǎo dào yì zhāng jiù zhào piàn.

blocks.hanzi: 照片上是一条河，河边有一些老建筑。
blocks.translation: In the photo is a river, and by the river there are some old buildings.
blocks.pinyin: zhàopiàn shàng shì yī tiáo hé ， hé biān yǒu yīxiē lǎo jiànzhù 。

blocks.hanzi: 他决定返回河边，看看现在变成了什么样子。
blocks.translation: He decided to return to the riverside to see what it had become.
blocks.pinyin: tā juédìng fǎnhuí hébiān, kànkan xiànzài biànchéng le shénme yàngzi.

blocks.hanzi: 这里变化真大啊！
blocks.translation: What great changes have taken place here!
blocks.pinyin: zhèlǐ biànhuà zhēn dà a

blocks.hanzi: 年轻人，你认识这里吗？
blocks.translation: Young man, do you recognize this place?
blocks.pinyin: niánqīngrén, nǐ rènshi zhèlǐ ma?

blocks.hanzi: 我有一张过去的照片，想找到拍摄的地方。
blocks.translation: I have an old photo and want to find the place where it was taken.
blocks.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī zhāng guòqù de zhàopiàn, xiǎng zhǎodào pāishè de dìfang.

blocks.hanzi: 老人看了看照片，眼睛突然亮了。
blocks.translation: The old man looked at the photo, and his eyes suddenly lit up.
blocks.pinyin: lǎo rén kàn le kàn zhào piàn ， yǎn jīng tū rán liàng le 。

blocks.hanzi: 这张照片是我拍的！
blocks.translation: I took this photo!
blocks.pinyin: zhè zhāng zhàopiàn shì wǒ pāi de ！

blocks.hanzi: 真的吗？您还记得当时的情景吗？
blocks.translation: Really? Do you still remember the scene at that time?
blocks.pinyin: zhēn de ma? nín hái jìde dāngshí de qíngjǐng ma?

blocks.hanzi: 当然记得。那时我还年轻，喜欢在河边拍照。
blocks.translation: Of course I remember. At that time I was still young, I liked to take photos by the river.
blocks.pinyin: dāngrán jìde. nàshí wǒ hái niánqīng, xǐhuān zài hébiān pāizhào.

blocks.hanzi: 老人指着远处的高楼说：“那些建筑以前都是矮房子。”
blocks.translation: The old man pointed to the tall building in the distance and said, “Those buildings were all low houses before.”
blocks.pinyin: lǎo rén zhǐ zhe yuǎn chù de gāo lóu shuō ：“ nà xiē jiàn zhù yǐ qián dōu shì ǎi fáng zi 。”

blocks.hanzi: 城市的变化真快，记忆中的样子都变了。
blocks.translation: city
blocks.pinyin: chéngshì

blocks.hanzi: 是啊，但照片帮我们记住了过去。
blocks.translation: Yes, but photos help us remember the past.
blocks.pinyin: Shì a, dàn zhàopiàn bāng wǒmen jìzhù le guòqù.

blocks.hanzi: 您能再拍一张现在的照片吗？我想对比一下。
blocks.translation: Can you take another photo of the present? I want to compare.
blocks.pinyin: Nín néng zài pāi yì zhāng xiànzài de zhàopiàn ma? Wǒ xiǎng duìbǐ yíxià.

blocks.hanzi: 老人微笑着拿出相机，拍摄了同样的河岸。
blocks.translation: The old man smiled and took out his camera, photographing the same riverbank.
blocks.pinyin: lǎo rén wēi xiào zhe ná chū xiàng jī ， pāi shè le tóng yàng de hé àn 。

blocks.hanzi: 李伟看着两张照片，一张是过去，一张是现在。
blocks.translation: Li Wei looks at two photos, one is the past, one is the present.
blocks.pinyin: Lǐ Wěi kànzhe liǎng zhāng zhàopiàn ， yī zhāng shì guòqù ， yī zhāng shì xiànzài 。

blocks.hanzi: 虽然建筑变了，但河水和记忆还在。
blocks.translation: Although the buildings have changed, the river water and memories remain.
blocks.pinyin: suīrán jiànzhù biàn le ， dàn héshuǐ hé jìyì hái zài 。

blocks.hanzi: 谢谢您，这张照片对我来说很珍贵。
blocks.translation: Thank you, this photo is very precious to me.
blocks.pinyin: xièxie nín, zhè zhāng zhàopiàn duì wǒ lái shuō hěn zhēnguì.

blocks.hanzi: 不用谢。记住，变化是自然的，但记忆是永远的。
blocks.translation: You're welcome. Remember, change is natural, but memory is eternal.
blocks.pinyin: bú yòng xiè。jì zhù，biàn huà shì zì rán de，dàn jì yì shì yǒng yuǎn de。

blocks.hanzi: 李伟把两张照片放在一起，一张记录了过去，一张记录了现在。
blocks.translation: Li Wei put two photos together, one recorded the past, one recorded the present.
blocks.pinyin: Lǐ Wěi bǎ liǎng zhāng zhàopiàn fàng zài yìqǐ ， yì zhāng jìlù le guòqù ， yì zhāng jìlù le xiànzài 。

blocks.hanzi: 他想到，虽然城市变化很大，但记忆中的河边永远不会变。
blocks.translation: He thought that although the city had changed a lot, the riverside in his memory would never change.
blocks.pinyin: tā xiǎng dào ， suī rán chéng shì biàn huà hěn dà ， dàn jì yì zhōng de hé biān yǒng yuǎn bù huì biàn 。

blocks.hanzi: 这张照片让我看到了时间的痕迹。
blocks.translation: This photo shows me the traces of time.
blocks.pinyin: zhè zhāng zhàopiàn ràng wǒ kàn dào le shíjiān de hénjì 。

blocks.hanzi: 是的，照片帮我们记住了那些重要的时刻。
blocks.translation: Yes, photos help us remember those important moments.
blocks.pinyin: shì de, zhàopiàn bāng wǒmen jìzhù le nàxiē zhòngyào de shíkè.

blocks.hanzi: 李伟告别了老人，带着两张照片返回家中。
blocks.translation: Li Wei said goodbye to the old man and returned home with two photos.
blocks.pinyin: Lǐ Wěi gàobié le lǎorén, dài zhe liǎng zhāng zhàopiàn fǎnhuí jiāzhōng.

blocks.hanzi: 他知道，这次返回河边让他找到了比照片更珍贵的东西——记忆。
blocks.translation: He knew that this return to the riverside made him find something more precious than photos — memories.
blocks.pinyin: tā zhīdào zhè cì fǎnhuí hé biān ràng tā zhǎodào le bǐ zhàopiàn gèng zhēnguì de dōngxi jìyì
